components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-button-primary{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:550;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:36px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dbe2e7);border-radius:var(--radius,6px);cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease-out,color .16s ease-out;background:var(--accent,#245e89);border-color:var(--accent,#245e89);color:var(--paper,#fff);}.ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#174d76;}.ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled){background:#d9e6f0;}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#2c79b3);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:default;}

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:550;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:36px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dbe2e7);border-radius:var(--radius,6px);cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease-out,color .16s ease-out;background:var(--paper,#fff);color:var(--ink,#182a36);}.ds-button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-soft,#e8f0f7);border-color:#a4b7c7;}.ds-button-secondary:active:not(:disabled){background:#d9e6f0;}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#2c79b3);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button-secondary:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:default;}

components.name: Quiet button
components.css: .ds-button-quiet{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:550;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:36px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dbe2e7);border-radius:var(--radius,6px);cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease-out,color .16s ease-out;background:transparent;border-color:transparent;color:var(--muted,#566875);}.ds-button-quiet:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-soft,#e8f0f7);border-color:#a4b7c7;}.ds-button-quiet:active:not(:disabled){background:#d9e6f0;}.ds-button-quiet:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#2c79b3);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button-quiet:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:default;}

components.name: Text field
components.css: .ds-field{display:block;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#182a36);}.ds-field span{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:550;margin-bottom:8px;}.ds-field input{width:100%;padding:10px 11px;border:1px solid #b9c7d0;border-radius:var(--radius,6px);background:var(--paper,#fff);color:var(--ink,#182a36);font:13px/1.7 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:#7c99ad;}.ds-field input:focus{border-color:var(--accent,#245e89);background:#fcfdff;}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#2c79b3);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Section choice
components.css: .ds-section{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:550;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:36px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dbe2e7);border-radius:var(--radius,6px);cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease-out,color .16s ease-out;font-size:12px;min-height:32px;padding:6px 10px;border:0;background:var(--accent-soft,#e8f0f7);color:#164f79;}.ds-section:hover{background:var(--accent-soft,#e8f0f7);}.ds-section:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#2c79b3);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Version choice
components.css: .ds-rail{background:var(--rail,#172f40);padding:16px;}.ds-version{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:550;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:36px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dbe2e7);border-radius:var(--radius,6px);cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease-out,color .16s ease-out;display:block;text-align:left;min-height:65px;padding:12px 10px;border:0;background:#305168;color:#fff;width:100%;line-height:1.5;}.ds-version strong{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;}.ds-version small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#cfdeea;line-height:1.6;margin-top:3px;}.ds-version:hover{background:#274458;}.ds-version:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#2c79b3);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Mode selector
components.description: Selected editing mode on inset track.
components.css: .ds-track{display:inline-flex;border:1px solid var(--line,#dbe2e7);border-radius:6px;padding:2px;background:#f3f5f7;}.ds-track button{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:550;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:36px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#dbe2e7);border-radius:var(--radius,6px);cursor:pointer;transition:background .16s ease-out,color .16s ease-out;font-size:12px;min-height:28px;padding:5px 12px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#566875);border-radius:4px;}.ds-track button[aria-pressed=true]{background:white;color:var(--accent,#245e89);box-shadow:0 1px 3px #142e451a;}.ds-track button:hover{background:var(--accent-soft,#e8f0f7);}.ds-track button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#2c79b3);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Proof sheet
components.description: Square document sheet on a cool proof canvas; sample contains no resume data.

narrative.overview:
A proof workbench puts quiet editing surfaces beside a real generated document. Marine navigation, white sheets and a cool canvas separate regions without ornamental framing. Compact bilingual interface typography keeps the emphasis on writing and checking.

This system applies only to `tools/resume-studio`, the local Resume Studio. It does not prescribe the incumbent public portfolio, its typography, or generated PDF page design.
keyCharacteristics: Cool tonal separation with restrained blue selection.
Compact bilingual controls and readable field leading.
A document sheet receives depth; editing regions remain flat.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: Selection and freshness use explicit labels or semantic state attributes alongside color.

rules.name: The Sheet Has Depth Rule
rules.body: Reserve ambient shadows for the proof sheet, active segmented choice and transient rendering notice; keep structural regions flat.

dos: Do use blue for actions, selection and focus, with text or semantic state attributes to explain state.
Do preserve distinct editing and document surfaces across responsive layouts.
Do show unsaved and preview freshness states independently.
Do use the system sans for compact bilingual interface text and monospace for source.
donts: Don't apply this local workbench system to the public portfolio or PDF page typography.
Don't use color alone to communicate save or generation state.
Don't turn the proof canvas into a collection of decorative cards.
